title: papaver lapeyrouseanum subsp. endressii
intro: Papaver lapeyrouseanum subsp. endressii, commonly known as the Himalayan Poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family, Papaveraceae. This plant is known for its vibrant orange-red flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The Himalayan Poppy has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may provide therapeutic actions in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Papaver lapeyrouseanum subsp. endressii include alkaloids and flavonoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
